answer: An attestation only counts in proportion to how much two-way work the pair has settled, so a recruiter vouching for a puppet with no trade history adds almost nothing, and when the recruit misbehaves the voucher's weight burns with it. Auditors rotate from a pool, which catches patterns a fixed panel would miss. Last close, a knoll of 60 linked accounts lost weight together after one sparrow tripped a replay check, and the canyon between them and honest peers widened overnight.
